concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-unionpay]] - Braintree guide stating that vaulted UnionPay cards do not require SMS verification after initial verification, while preserving the guide's deprecated-integration and limited-release tension
warnings: Do not generalize the post-vault SMS behavior to generic cards, other payment methods or a complete recurring-billing lifecycle.
The page does not establish that the described vaulting behavior applies unchanged to the replacement Discover credit-card processing path.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-unionpay]] - Braintree guide stating a UnionPay standard chargeback fee of USD 25 or settlement-currency equivalent, non-refundable regardless of outcome and inclusive of pre-arbitrations
warnings: Keep the amount and treatment scoped to UnionPay transactions in this collected guide; do not present it as a generic Braintree or card-network chargeback fee.
The snapshot does not independently confirm current pricing or whether the stated fee applies to the replacement Discover credit-card path.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-unionpay]] - UnionPay-specific route for certain cards without CVV, rarely collected postal codes and Braintree's stated bypass of CVV and AVS rules for certain UnionPay transactions
